name: Effect button
for: A primary call to action and an optional secondary action with colour feedback.
how: Use the system button styles. Existing effect hosts remain hidden.
rules: Only the primary call to action, or one button pair, per page.
The label keeps 4.5:1 during hover and press.
The fill is even across the button: no bright patch at one end.
Demo notes ('hover to see it') belong to the showcase, never to the component markup.
a11y: Keep the native link or button and its keyboard focus ring.
